title: Concerning the Interpretation of the Five Words that are proclaimed in the Universe

paragraphs.text: Once again the disciples [questioned the apostle. They say to] him: Recount to us, our master, of these five words that are procl[aim]ed in the sect of the Baptis[ts ... they] occur in other sects. [Also, thei]r name is proclaimed by they[w]ho are called 'Purified Ones', as they say this '[[First] Life' and the 'Second Life' ... ...] make a heart together with the mind [...] and the l[aw ...
[...] call it by this name is the Father, the l[ife ...] this unnameable, whom no one [...] his name.

⟨p.45⟩
The second [word is the Thir]d Ambassador [...] of life, whom they also call the father of [...] [...] the first Father.
